Definition: probably akin to G5338 and thus to G5346; to utter a clear sound, i.e. (generally) to proclaim:--speak.
BiblicalUsage: Phthengomai means to utter a clear sound, to speak out plainly. The dumb ass speaks with a man's voice in 2 Peter 2:16, and the council commands Peter and John not to speak at all in the name of Jesus in Acts 4:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God can give speech to a donkey, and men cannot silence the name of Jesus.
